     Subject: Local Law 58/87 - Change of Use of Spaces in Existing
               Buildings


     REFERENCES:    Administrative    Code    §27-123.1,   "Alterations,
     additions, repairs and changes in occupancy or use requiring
     facilities   for   peqple   having    physical  disabilities"   and
     subarticle two of article two of subchapter four of chapter one
     of-292.1
          title twentyet seq."),
                              seven ("§§27  "facilities for
     People having Physical Disabilities."

     PURPOSE: To clarify the requirements of Code §27-123.1 pertaining
     to the accessibility of a space in a building where the occupancy
     type or use has changed.

     EFFECTIVE DATE: Immediately

    SPECIFICS: Section 27-123(b) states that when there is a change
     in the occupancy type or use of a space in a building, "such
    space" must comply with the provisions of §§27-292.1 et seq.

     The entrance to a space in a building is considered a part of
     "such space." Therefore, when there is a change in the occupancy
     type cr use of a space in a building, such entrance must comply
     with the provisions of Code §§27-292.1 et seq. This may requir
    e widening the doorway.   Moreover, when the change in occupancy
     type or use is made to a space that has direct access to grade,
such access is also to be considered part of "such space" and,
therefore, must also be made accessible pursuant to the
requirements of Code M7-292.1 et seq. This may require the
removal of steps and the widening of the corridor that leads to
the doorway_

The Commissioner may waive the requirements pursuant to
§27-292.6.
